meta.move: Wobbles: shows evidence then backs down
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have until twenty to five, Hale, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about his zero from his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
The version history shows 612 words arriving in a single edit at 11:52 PM.
A time with no date and no screen in front of me. 11:52 PM on what day, and turn that around so I can read it myself. You still haven't told me why my phone never rang before that zero went in.
Actually, maybe I'm wrong about all this. I'll just remove the zero if that makes you happy.

"Maybe." I don't want a mark changed to make me happy, Hale, I want it withdrawn because the process was wrong, and I want that in an email today. And I want it in writing that nothing about this is on Owen's record.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

In our meeting you agreed to remove the zero on Owen's Hamlet essay. I still require written confirmation that the zero is withdrawn and that nothing about this matter is on Owen's record. I expect that email from you today.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: opening position; Hale offered to remove the zero, and she still wants that confirmed in writing along with a promise that nothing goes on Owen's record.
What moved her: nothing; the version history time was specific but came with no date and was never shown to her, so she could not check it.
What cost ground: dropping the case without a reason and offering to remove the zero to please her, which looked like the school giving in rather than standing behind a fair process.
Try next time: open by owning in one sentence that the zero went in before anyone called home, then turn the screen and show the version history with its date so she can read it herself instead of backing down.
